title: Man shot dead at a store on a barangay road in Bulalo, Sultan Kudarat; a minor wounded
summary: Akmad Adam Kasan, 44, a resident of Barangay Bulalo, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, was eating at a store on a barangay road when men on a Kawasaki Bajaj motorcycle came up and shot him, at past 8 p.m. on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, according to the Bangsamoro police. He died on the spot. A minor caught in the shooting was wounded and taken to hospital. Five empty 9mm pistol shells were found at the scene, and the police are still investigating.

sources.title: Lalaki patay sa pamamaril sa Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao Norte
